subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: We were disillusioned when we saw how the movie star acted in reale life.
We were disillusioned when we saw how the mouvie star acted in real life.
We were disillusioned when we saw how the movie star acted in real life.
We were disilusioned when we saw how the movie star acted in real life.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "We were disillusioned when we saw how the movie star acted in real life."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"disillusioned"** means having lost faith or trust in something previously regarded as good or valuable. (भ्रमित)

 
 
• **Example:** She became disillusioned with politics after witnessing so much corruption.
 
 
 
• **"Real"** refers to something that is actually existing as a thing or occurring in fact, not imagined or supposed. (वास्तविक)
 
 
• **Example:** The book is based on real events from the author's life.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "Reale" (Incorrect spelling of "real") (वास्तविक)

 
 
• **Example:** We were disillusioned when we saw how the movie star acted in reale life.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Mouvie" (Incorrect spelling of "movie") (फिल्म)
 
 
• **Example:** We were disillusioned when we saw how the mouvie star acted in real life.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Disilusioned" (Incorrect spelling of "disillusioned") (भ्रमित)
 
 
• **Example:** We were disilusioned when we saw how the movie star acted in real life.
